item.title: Abstract 0.12.0-nightly.55
item.description:
What's Changed

New

  • Agents look up the conversations that shaped the code they're changing, so they respect earlier decisions by @wesguirra in #80
  • Permission answers can be remembered for a project, for a command or path pattern you choose by @wesguirra in #82
  • Plan and Ask modes for every agent, and a plan is approved as a document before work starts by @wesguirra in #83
  • One action pauses every running agent and every automation, and one action resumes them by @wesguirra in #85
  • Plugins can add a tab to a chat's side panel, a chat menu item, ⌘K commands and a Settings page by @wesguirra in #89
  • Agent profiles: save a named setup (agent, model, effort, permissions, instructions, skills) and start chats or automations from it by @wesguirra in #86
  • Plugins can read usage, turn times and chat transcripts when you grant it by @wesguirra in #90
  • Automations decide what happens when a run is still going, catch up missed runs, and can skip when nothing changed by @wesguirra in #87
  • Plugins can reach the web addresses they declare, and use secrets you keep in the Keychain by @wesguirra in #91
  • Show your chats as a Kanban board on the phone, grouped by what they need from you by @wesguirra in #92
  • Bring Plan and Ask modes with plan approval cards to the phone by @wesguirra in #93
  • Show each chat's project icon in the phone's chat list by @wesguirra in #94
  • Let automations choose what still-going, missed and unchanged runs do, from your phone by @wesguirra in #95
  • See code history lookups and ask the chat that wrote a line from your phone by @wesguirra in #96
  • Flag quiet and stalled chats on the phone by @wesguirra in #97
  • Pause everything and per project from your phone, with the paused banner by @wesguirra in #98
  • Use and edit agent profiles from your phone by @wesguirra in #99
  • Plugins can start chats, send messages, answer permissions and stop agents, with your approval for each kind of action by @wesguirra in #103
  • Choose a default Mac for a project from your phone by @wesguirra in #100
  • Remember permission answers from your phone, per project by @wesguirra in #104
  • Plugins can react to chat events and run on a schedule without their screen open by @wesguirra in #105
  • Ask another agent to review a chat's changes before you accept them, with its findings as line comments by @wesguirra in #106
  • One queue to answer every permission request and question waiting across your chats by @wesguirra in #107
  • A chat can follow its pull request, so new review comments and failed checks go to its agent by @wesguirra in #108
  • Save what a chat learned as a skill or as project instructions, reviewed as a diff by @wesguirra in #109
  • Plugins can give agents tools, through Abstract's own MCP server by @wesguirra in #110
  • Connect MCP tools once per project, choose which agents get them, and which actions need your OK by @wesguirra in #113
  • Plugins follow Abstract's theme from the first frame, share a polished design kit, and the bundled plugins use tabs by @wesguirra in #114
  • Messages sent while the agent works are queued, or steer or interrupt the turn, for every agent by @wesguirra in #112
  • Manage skills once in Abstract and give them to every agent in a project by @wesguirra in #115
  • Workflows hand a chat from profile to profile, automations start on chat events, and settings get a cleaner layout by @wesguirra in #116
  • GitHub and Linear links in a chat show their live status by @wesguirra in #117
  • Plugins can run a command-line tool they declare, and answer for a project's code host by @wesguirra in #118
  • Abstract's GitHub features move into an official GitHub plugin that any code host can follow by @wesguirra in #120
  • Abstract's Linear features move into an official Linear plugin that any issue tracker can follow by @wesguirra in #119
  • Each turn can show exactly how its agent was started: command, folder, model and environment, with secrets hidden by @wesguirra in #124
  • An official Bitbucket plugin brings pull requests, checks and merging to Bitbucket projects, using bkt by @wesguirra in #125
  • An official Jira plugin lets you find and attach Jira issues in chats, using Atlassian's acli by @wesguirra in #126
  • Projects link to Linear or Jira and show the right issue icon in chat by @wesguirra in #131
  • Icons use one picker across projects, profiles, workflows and plugins by @wesguirra in #133
  • Plugins come from a signed catalog, and updates that ask for more wait for your review by @wesguirra in #134
  • The phone sidebar keeps chats in focus and returns to the right place by @wesguirra in #137
  • Phone chat rows make work and review status easy to scan by @wesguirra in #136
  • The phone composer makes settings and connection feel at home by @wesguirra in #138
  • Attach photos from the library in the phone composer by @wesguirra in #143
  • Manage Mac plugins from the phone by @wesguirra in #144
  • Plugins are easy to find and manage in a searchable gallery by @wesguirra in #145
  • Compact a chat's context in every agent with /compact, and see it happen by @wesguirra in #146
  • Make automations easier to create, run and follow by @wesguirra in #153
  • Tool rows show each CLI and MCP server’s icon by @wesguirra in #156
  • New app icon on Mac and phone by @wesguirra in #159
  • Chats can hand sub-tasks to other chats on any agent, wait for them and get their results back by @wesguirra in #160
  • A dashboard shows work in progress, what's waiting for you, spend against budget and the last two weeks by @wesguirra in #161

Fixed

  • A working chat that goes quiet is flagged, and you're told after 15 minutes without output by @wesguirra in #84
  • Fix startup after upgrading from earlier nightlies by @wesguirra in #101
  • Chats no longer say the GitHub CLI is needed when gh is installed and signed in by @wesguirra in #122
  • Plugin background work stays responsive after launch and under load by @wesguirra in #123
  • Automation branches wait for the agent to name the work by @wesguirra in #127
  • Draft: Pull requests keep working when you sign in to GitHub after launch, use GitHub Enterprise or an SSH host alias, or have more than 100 PRs, and failures say why by @wesguirra in #128
  • Bitbucket sign-in works with the installed bkt CLI by @wesguirra in #130
  • Codex automation chats start instead of exiting with code 1 by @wesguirra in #132
  • Bitbucket Cloud pull requests load without an Invalid pagelen error by @wesguirra in #135
  • Phone menus fit their actions by @wesguirra in #142
  • Phone profiles and automations are easier to scan by @wesguirra in #140
  • Phone chat stays at the latest activity as messages arrive by @wesguirra in #141
  • Keep chat where you left it while new messages arrive by @wesguirra in #150
  • Open a chat on the first click in the side panel by @wesguirra in #152
  • Show pull requests from nested repos and submodules by @wesguirra in #151
  • Keep the side panel fast with many chats by @wesguirra in #155
  • Keep center tabs visible at every width by @wesguirra in #154

Agents

  • Muse Code chats count in Usage and show their tokens per turn, like the other agents by @wesguirra in #121
  • PRs, pushes and commits made by agents appear in chats immediately by @wesguirra in #147
  • Show Muse thinking in chat by @wesguirra in #157

Other changes

  • ABS-153 · Phone chat rows make work and review status easy to scan by @wesguirra in #139

Under the hood

  • Spike: how one chat hands sub-tasks to other chats, waits for them and hears back by @wesguirra in #88
  • Speed up required checks with parallel builds and caching by @wesguirra in #102
  • Attach demo-mode screenshots of every screen to each pull request by @wesguirra in #111
  • Spike: share the project icon picker with profiles and plugin views by @wesguirra in #129
  • Add design note for simpler Automations by @wesguirra in #149
  • Decide how tool rows get their icons by @wesguirra in #148

item.title: Abstract 0.11.0
item.description:
What's Changed

New

  • ⌘F finds text in the chat, including inside tool calls by @wesguirra in #40
  • ⌘⇧F searches the contents of every file in the chat's worktree from the Files pane by @wesguirra in #41
  • ⌘F finds text in the file open in the Files tab and in the Review tab's diff by @wesguirra in #42
  • A new Ink theme: true black background with high contrast, also used when macOS's Increase contrast is on by @wesguirra in #53
  • The sidebar groups chats by what they need from you, and shows each chat's agent, age, pull request and checks at a glance by @wesguirra in #48
  • Abstract has its new Horizonte icon on the Mac and the phone, with a white version for light appearance by @wesguirra in #51
  • The phone groups chats by what they need from you, and shows each chat's agent, age, pull request and checks at a glance by @wesguirra in #54
  • The Mac chat composer opens at three lines and sends with Return by @wesguirra in #63
  • Files Claude changes through shell commands show their diff in the chat, like its edits do by @wesguirra in #68
  • Draft: Sidebar PRs show a clear check result beside their number by @wesguirra in #66
  • Choose a default Mac for a project by @wesguirra in #70
  • Abstract lets you install, enable and open plugins by @wesguirra in #73
  • Chat rows show their project icon in the Mac sidebar by @wesguirra in #76
  • Ask the chat that wrote a line about it, straight from the Files or Review tab by @wesguirra in #78
  • Kanban shows chats by progress with project filters by @wesguirra in #77
  • Run an automation on a paired Mac by @wesguirra in #81

Fixed

  • The Review tab refreshes only when the changes did, without flicker or losing your place by @wesguirra in #36
  • Automation runs get branches named for their work as soon as the agent starts, and a chat follows its branch when it's renamed by @wesguirra in #37
  • Project naming instructions shape every new chat's title and branch for every agent, and Abstract says when it couldn't apply them by @wesguirra in #38
  • The branch shown above the reply box uses a branch icon and says it's a branch, not the worktree icon by @wesguirra in #39
  • Describing a new automation for Draft with AI happens in a multi-line text area, with its shortcut shown by @wesguirra in #43
  • Chats on a paired Mac notify you when they need you, finish or fail, like chats on this Mac by @wesguirra in #45
  • On the phone, the branch above the reply box uses the branch icon, says Branch, and is only as wide as its name by @wesguirra in #47
  • Every turn shows how long it took for every agent, even after a restart, and each chat shows its total working time by @wesguirra in #50
  • The phone shows every paired Mac's projects and chats together, without switching Macs by @wesguirra in #49
  • Accepting changes from a chat on another Mac applies them on that Mac and never touches files on this one by @wesguirra in #44
  • Chats are named for the work they deliver, take their pull request's title once there is one, and never end up named after tests or checks by @wesguirra in #56
  • Side panel tabs and controls stay visible in narrow windows by @wesguirra in #60
  • Phone messages appear immediately and send only once by @wesguirra in #58
  • The phone composer stays comfortable and the chat stays at the latest message by @wesguirra in #59
  • Phone chat rows keep PR checks and review status readable by @wesguirra in #64
  • Every Codex reply appears beneath the message it answers by @wesguirra in #65
  • Chats on a paired Mac show when it's unreachable, and nothing you send to them is lost without telling you by @wesguirra in #67
  • The side panel header and chat border align at narrow widths by @wesguirra in #74

Agents

  • Muse Code runs chats with Muse Wonder by @wesguirra in #69
  • Muse Code commands show files, changes and searches in the chat by @wesguirra in #75

Under the hood

  • CI runs the git-heavy test suites one at a time, so timing tests stop failing at random by @wesguirra in #55
  • Abstract records what each turn changed and why, and links every commit back to its chat and turn by @wesguirra in #57
  • Wait for tests before preparing nightly builds by @wesguirra in #61
  • Build nightly without waiting for tests by @wesguirra in #62
  • Spike: find structured Muse Code tool events for detailed chat rows by @wesguirra in #71
  • Spike: define a safe plugin boundary for Abstract views and data by @wesguirra in #72
  • Draft: Spike: prove ten more coding agents can show complete chat activity by @wesguirra in #79

Full Changelog: v0.10.0...0be618c

item.title: Abstract 0.10.0
item.description:
What's Changed

New

  • Add the abstract command line to create and drive chats by @wesguirra in #3
  • feat: smarter git actions and PR pane, ⌘↩ send button, narrower side tabs by @wesguirra in #5
  • feat: pin chats to the top of their project, fix right-click on tabs by @wesguirra in #6
  • Automations run in chats; standalone chats; set up chats before their agent by @wesguirra in #7
  • Fast, uncut text boxes and a / command menu in the composer by @wesguirra in #9
  • Submodules: review each repository on its own, and ship them safely by @wesguirra in #10
  • Submodules: update, pull, commit and push the repository you're working in by @wesguirra in #13
  • Control Mac chats from iPhone and Android by @wesguirra in #16
  • Connect to paired Macs over the internet by @wesguirra in #23
  • Images open with a proper preview in Files, and image paths in the chat open that preview when clicked by @wesguirra in #31
  • The Automations list is grouped by project and can be filtered by project, agent and state by @wesguirra in #32
  • The chat says when Claude is retrying or near its usage limit, and when the limit resets by @wesguirra in #34
  • Automation runs are named for what their agent worked on by @wesguirra in #35

Fixed

  • Make chats that abstract creates usable in the app right away by @wesguirra in #8
  • Change a project's default agent, permission policy and base branch in Project Settings by @wesguirra in #15
  • Mobile chat connects to Macs faster and handles reconnects cleanly by @wesguirra in #18
  • Don't block every push on a repository with no upstream and no base by @wesguirra in #20
  • Deploy relay to an existing one-node Lightsail service by @wesguirra in #24
  • Deploy the exact relay image registered in Lightsail by @wesguirra in #25
  • Show mobile chat quotes on the dark chat background by @wesguirra in #19
  • Abstract's background git runs within a hard process budget and time limit, so it can never exhaust the Mac's processes by @wesguirra in #26
  • Improve mobile chat, review, and settings screens by @wesguirra in #27
  • OpenCode's file edits show the file and its diff in the chat, like Claude's do by @wesguirra in #33
  • Pressing Stop ends the agent's turn quietly instead of marking the chat as failed by @wesguirra in #30

Agents

  • Add OpenCode, retire Ollama/LM Studio as agents, per-agent defaults, composer fixes by @wesguirra in #4
  • Count OpenCode's tokens and cost in Usage by @wesguirra in #17

Other changes

  • Tickets go through Linear triage before the roadmap by @wesguirra in #12

Under the hood

  • Add the weekly roadmap agents deliver against by @wesguirra in #11
  • Group release notes into features, fixes, agents and internals by @wesguirra in #14
  • Add manual deployment for the internet relay on Lightsail by @wesguirra in #21
  • Plan the roadmap in Linear, where every ticket is reviewed before it's built by @wesguirra in #22
  • Allow the idle agent test more time on busy CI runners by @wesguirra in #28
  • Spike: read git inside Abstract with no subprocesses at all by @wesguirra in #29

Full Changelog: v0.9.0...a21f4ab

item.title: Abstract 0.9.0
item.description:
Abstract is now signed and notarized, and updates itself (Settings → General → Updates, where you can also switch to nightly builds). Coming from 0.8.x or earlier? Download this version once; updates are automatic from here.

What's Changed

  • Release strategy: cut releases, nightly builds, signed updates by @wesguirra in #1
  • Keep the previous nightly DMG; clarify switching back to Stable by @wesguirra in #2

New Contributors

  • @wesguirra made their first contribution in #1
